Cefotaxime may be used with an aminoglycoside as synergy may occur against some Gram-negative or- ganisms, but the drugs should be given separately. It has sometimes been used with another beta lactam to broaden the spectrum of activity. Cefotaxime has also been used with metronidazole in the treatment of mixed aerobic-anaerobic infections. ◊ General references to third-generation cephalosporins. 1. Neu HC, et al., eds.
